review.head-advanced (S26): a closed review request for the unchanged head is not recreated however it was closed. Production lists only open beads for the work-beads query, so the old sync (with no ledger row for it) cannot see the closed request and plans a fresh one; the new decider reads the closed item and plans nothing. The feedback cycle is planned on both sides: the old sync plans one for every comment the invisible closed cycle covered, the new decider only for the comment no earlier cycle covered.
